sourceRecords.title: 16 MW floating wind goes live
sourceRecords.sourceText: Switchgear Magazine reported that CNOOC's Haiyou Anlan, described as a 16 MW tension-leg-platform floating wind unit, began operations and supplies offshore oil and gas facilities through a 4.3 km subsea cable.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public webpage; source text stored as concise factual evidence for manual archive prototype review.

sourceRecords.title: Sumitomo Corp. acquires stake in Gwynt Glas offshore wind farm
sourceRecords.sourceText: Energy Global reported that Sumitomo acquired a 33.3 percent equity interest in Gwynt Glas, a floating offshore wind project being developed by EDF power solutions UK and Ireland and ESB in the Celtic Sea.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public webpage; source text stored as concise factual evidence for manual archive prototype review.

sourceRecords.title: Encomara prepares Squid connection system for floating wind trials
sourceRecords.sourceText: Windtech International reported that Encomara was preparing inshore trials at Ardersier for Squid, a 40-tonne floating wind connection system supporting mooring lines, power cables, and subsea connectors.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public webpage; source text stored as concise factual evidence for manual archive prototype review.

sourceRecords.title: Enova funds Windeed floating wind demonstrator study
sourceRecords.sourceText: Windtech International reported that Enova awarded funding to Windeed for a feasibility study for a full-scale floating offshore wind demonstrator in Norway with Aibel and AF Gruppen.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public webpage; source text stored as concise factual evidence for manual archive prototype review.

sourceRecords.title: France selects five ports for floating wind infrastructure
sourceRecords.sourceText: Windtech International reported that France selected Cherbourg, Brest, Nantes-Saint-Nazaire, Port-la-Nouvelle, and Marseille-Fos for France 2030 funding to support floating wind manufacturing, assembly, and turbine integration.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public webpage; source text stored as concise factual evidence for manual archive prototype review.
